output_text: "A 17,000-tonne drilling rig, carrying 280 tonnes of diesel oil, broke free from its tug during a storm and grounded off Lewis, Scotland, on Monday. The Maritime and Coastguard Agency has warned sightseers to stay away and has set up a 300m temporary exclusion zone around Dalmore beach. A salvage team is inspecting the rig, and officials aim to carry out work on it while the weather is favorable. The rig is being towed from Norway to Malta for scrapping."
